method: Isolated anonymous Chrome; protection enabled during the same real playing pre-roll. No ad injection, stream rewrite, personal profile or advertiser click. Browser audio output muted separately.

preRoll.mainProperties: Visible, rate 1, unmuted, no media error during observed interval
preRoll.endState: Player error after about 49 seconds of main content; full-video reliability is not established.

midRoll.status: Not verified with a real ad
midRoll.reason: A separate ordinary progress-bar seek with protection OFF stalled on media-CDN HTTP 403. Synthetic actual-media pre/mid-roll tests passed; they are not live-ad evidence.

controls.connectedChrome: Computer Use stopped because browser URL could not be verified; no further connected-browser input was attempted.
controls.noExtension: A separate headed profile with no extension also failed around 45 seconds.
controls.userSuppliedVideo: No ad inventory in isolated trials; not a blocking success. User reports healthy playback and ads in their Chrome.
controls.otherTrials: Earlier long ads remained concealed/muted without automatic return within the observation interval. Native Skip availability/acceptance varies; waiting may remain.

limits: One successful real pre-roll is not a universal success rate.
Real mid-roll, server-inserted ads and full-video playback remain unverified.
Sample counts are polling observations, not unique-ad counts.
Cookies, signed URLs, IPs and user-supplied video identity excluded.
